title: Wingless Birds Episode 13
description: Produced by Ata Türkoğlu-Koin Film, directed by Kemal  Melis Tüzüngüç, Ümit İbrahim Kantarcılar, Ahmet Varlı, Deniz Bolışık, Fatih Al, Servet Pandur and Seda Türkmen share their main roles in Kanatız Birds, written by Hakan Haksun.   The story of a young and beautiful mother who has endured all kinds of sacrifices for her children and the intertwined story of a young and beautiful mother who has been struggling to hold on to life… The wingless birds describing that evil can arise from goodness, and the hope of evil, reflects the story of dramatic lives that fluttering for a sip of happiness.   Wingless birds to subscribe to Youtube channel; https://goo.gl/nacqtb  Cast: Melis Tüzüngüç (Zeynep), Ümit İbrahim Kantarcılar (Honor), Ahmet Varlı (Ahmet), Deniz Bolışık (Nefise), Fatih Al (Muzaffer), Servet Pandur (Azime), Seda Türkmen (Tuba), Gizem Güneş (Cemre), Emir Özden (Emre), Karel Güntekin (Emel), Yusuf Baymaz (Suat)
